grove.name: The Glimmer Grove
grove.desc: A grove of pale trees whose leaves catch the light. Something flutters just out of sight among the blossoms — glimmermoths love sweet fruit.

tidepool.name: The Tidepool Shallows

burrow.name: The Warm Burrow
burrow.desc: A snug hollow beneath tree roots, oddly warm. A pair of eyes glints deep in the dark — ember-voles are drawn to sweetness.

grove.name: The Glimmer Grove
grove.desc: A grove of pale trees whose leaves catch the light. Something flutters just out of sight among the blossoms — glimmermoths love sweet fruit.

tidepool.name: The Tidepool Shallows
tidepool.desc: Clear pools among barnacled rocks. Ripples suggest something small and quick hides beneath — tide-newts dart after little fish.

burrow.name: The Warm Burrow
burrow.desc: A snug hollow beneath tree roots, oddly warm. A pair of eyes glints deep in the dark — ember-voles are drawn to sweetness.

sign.name: driftwood sign
sign.examine: Painted on driftwood: 'Cove critters are shy. Lure each with the treat it loves — moths to figs, newts to fish, voles to honey. Ask the ranger if unsure.'
sign.read: 'Moths to figs, newts to fish, voles to honey.'

sugar_fig.name: sugar fig
sugar_fig.examine: A sweet sugared fig. Something with a sweet tooth might love it.

blossoms.name: sweet blossoms
blossoms.examine: Fragrant blossoms where a glimmermoth flits, just out of reach.

pool.name: clear pool
pool.examine: A clear tidepool; a tide-newt darts among the rocks.

den.name: dark den
den.examine: A warm dark den where an ember-vole hides.

glimmermoth.name: glimmermoth
glimmermoth.examine: A moth with shimmering, light-catching wings. Caught!

tide_newt.name: tide-newt
tide_newt.examine: A quick little newt, still glistening. Caught!

ember_vole.name: ember-vole
ember_vole.examine: A warm, russet vole with ember-bright eyes. Caught!

ranger.name: the cove ranger
ranger.talk: The ranger tips her hat: 'Three critters, three treats. The glimmermoth wants the sugar fig, the tide-newt a silver fish, and the ember-vole loves honeycomb. Bring the right treat to the right spot, or they'll not show.'

last_events: It reads: 'Moths to figs, newts to fish, voles to honey.'
